items.rationale: The swerve impact is covered under 2.6.2, and the battery waiver overrides the below-80% exclusion in 2.6.8. The supplier's report establishes uneconomic repair under 7.1.10; estimate €1,400 for a new equivalent less €75 in salvage, with no additional deductible assumed because none is stated.
Section 7.1.9 limits payment to the pre-loss specification, already accounted for on line 1. The elective upgrade difference is excluded in full.

The cracked screen is covered impact damage under 2.6.2–2.6.4. Estimate €230 for a comparable screen and fitting under 7.1.7 and 7.1.10; the tablet shares the laptop's insured event, so no separate deductible applies.

Section 5.2.3 covers necessary diagnostics for both affected devices, even when one proves uneconomic to repair. Estimate €72 per device, or €144 total, below the shared €250 gross event cap; no invoice credit is stated.
Under 4.2.6 and 7.1.5, a carry bag is covered only if it was itself damaged in the event. The original bag was undamaged, so none of the replacement cost is payable.
Sections 3.5(f) and 7.1.8(e) exclude undertakings as to future performance, even when purchased with a covered replacement. No part of the warranty charge is payable.
Sections 3.5(d) and 4.3(c) exclude data recovery unless separately scheduled. No data-restoration extension is stated, and the battery waiver does not extend to data recovery.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separate administration and processing charges. The fee also relates to excluded data recovery, so no portion is payable.
